title: Build LLM sense scanning service
story: As a user, I want my writing analyzed for sensory language so that I can see which senses I engaged during the exercise.
acceptance_criteria: A service at src/services/analysisService.ts exports an analyzeText(text: string, apiKey: string) function
The function calls the Anthropic API with a structured prompt to identify sensory phrases
The response maps each identified phrase to one of: sight, sound, smell, taste, touch, organic, kinesthetic
The function returns a typed result: an array of { phrase: string, sense: string, startIndex: number, endIndex: number }
Prompt is defined as a named constant, not an inline string
Unit tests cover the response parsing logic with mocked API responses
